column19: Numerator: sum of annual average employees on OSHA ITA Form 300A for Amazon-classified establishments (deduped per establishment-year), NAICS 493110 as filed. ESTIMATE of Amazon US warehouse employment, not a strict bound (it is probably low because sites and agency workers are missing, and probably high where the numerator holds sites QCEW does not code to 493): Amazon does not disclose US logistics headcount; non-filing or unclassified sites, and employees of staffing agencies, are not in the numerator. Denominator: QCEW national NAICS 493 private annual average employment (all of NAICS 493, not only Amazon). Assumes Amazon sites are coded 493 in QCEW, which QCEW does not let us verify.
